- **CaseRecord:** title 1–80 after trim, 80 accepted / 81 rejected; empty and whitespace-only rejected. Subject trimmed, non-empty, max 80. Optional OCR metadata validates when present, and a card without OCR validates.
- **ConnectionRecord:** `association` / `provenance` only; `A::B === B::A`; reversed endpoints with the same canonical key parse; mismatched keys, self-links, malformed keys, and unknown fields rejected.
- **AttachmentRecord:** original/display/thumbnail kinds; JPEG/PNG/WebP MIME only; positive integer dimensions; lowercase 64-char SHA-256; Blob required; `bytes` must equal `blob.size`; unknown fields rejected.

- **CaseSummary:** nonnegative integer card and connection counts, required counts, defaults, malformed metadata rejected.

- **Tags:** trim, case-insensitive dedupe preserving first display casing and order, empty/overlong/eleventh tag rejected.
- **IDs/time:** generated IDs validate as UUIDs; fixed and system clocks produce ISO timestamp strings; invalid fixed clocks and exhausted sequences throw.
